title: Shared section presentation v2
description: Optional block envelope next to decoration. Sets how wide the section's content runs inside the page frame and which surface colours it uses. Closed enums only; the colours come from the site palette. Omit or clear the property to keep the legacy rendering. v2 adds an optional section anchor: a stable id buttons on the same page can point at (#anchor). Anchors share one namespace with rich-text heading anchors and are unique on a page.
